name: Motor feeder available indication
summary: Combines the defined protection and operating conditions into a feeder availability signal.
description: Combines the defined protection and operating conditions into a feeder availability signal. A motor feeder combines switching, motor protection and an operating command. Starting permission, running feedback and protection trip are different signals even where one relay or controller processes all of them.

In a switchroom motor-control panel, a ventilation motor can receive an automatic start request while a local selector and the motor protection determine whether the feeder is available. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Feeder health and authority” at the input and “Motor feeder available” at the output. Availability does not prove the process can run.
